title: Low-carbon lifestyles deliver broad emission reductions without automatic rebound: analysis code
description: Analysis pipeline (R) for the manuscript on whether low-carbon lifestyles (car-free, flight-free, meat-free) reduce emissions both directly and indirectly, and the role of environmental self-identity (ESI). The underlying individual-level bank-transaction and registry microdata are confidential and held in a secure Trusted Research Environment; a parametric synthetic-data generator (generate_synthetic_data.R) is included so that the full pipeline can be executed without the confidential data.
